question: India’s first fisheries business incubator was inaugurated by the Union Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Gurugram'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's first fishery business incubator** was inaugurated by the Union Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying** in Gurugram in 2021**.
 
• The government is expecting **22 million tonnes of fish production **and **Rs. One Lakh Crore export by 2025**.
 
• **The incubation unit** can serve as a **milestone **for the future of the fishery sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Shri Parshottam Rupala is the Minister for Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying.**
 
• Ministers of State for Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying namely **Dr. Sanjiv Kumar Balyan and Dr. L Murugan.**
